reason: M6 is one of several identical parallel devices (M6/M7/M8) between net016 and net018 with the same VIN1 gate; removing one simply reduces effective width/drive but keeps the same function via the remaining parallels.
M4 is one of several identical parallel devices (M3/M4/M5) between net018 and net1 with the same VIN1 gate; deleting one mainly lowers effective transconductance/drive without changing topology.

M13 is a diode-connected/biased pMOS element (net028 tied to its own drain/source path) that mainly provides a replicated bias/current path feeding inverter I2; removing it typically only disables that auxiliary replica while leaving the main cross-coupled/latch path (M19/M9 with M15/M10) intact.
impact_estimate: Low-to-moderate (may remove one bias/replica branch and change loading/levels for I2).
